title: Marketing/Business Development Coordinator
description:
Marketing & Business Development Coordinator
Bristol (hybrid)
£35,000 £40,000

Work remotely with just one day per week in the office and enjoy the flexibility to get on with things in a way that suits you. You ll also get five weeks holiday, giving you plenty of time to recharge.

You ll help shape our future by growing our client base and boosting our social media presence. You ll be doing what you love, with the freedom to put your stamp on things.

It s a chance to bring your big company experience and guide our small consultancy, making a real impact without layers of bureaucracy.

What you ll do

Marketing and Social Media will be your main focus, but you ll also get involved in supporting tenders, business development, and attending industry networking events. This variety will keep your skills sharp and open up new areas for you to develop.

You ll be turning technical information into engaging content that attracts the right attention and helps us stand out in a crowded market.

What you ll need

Proven social media marketing experience, ideally in the built environment or construction sector, so you know what it takes to win projects

Confident in creating website content, as this will be a key part of increasing our visibility and attracting new clients.

Ability to translate technical details into clear, compelling content that speaks to the right audience

About the company

We re a small civil and structural engineering consultancy working across commercial, leisure and defence sectors. As we grow, you ll play a key part in shaping our direction and making sure we stand out for all the right reasons.

You can call me, Darryl on (phone number removed) if you have questions. Or click 'apply' and I'll be in touch.

title: Home Based Marketing and Sales
description:
We are looking for independent self-motivated people to work from home on a part-time or full-time basis. The role is to develop a small number of regular re-ordering customers. The duties are a mixture of marketing, sales and customer service with the focus on customer retention. There is no requirement for cold calling.

This is an independent income opportunity, not a job or employment. The initial income is based on client orders, but after a month or two provides a consistent income from regular re-orders. It would be ideal to start part-time, but can be developed to provide a full-time income. The bigger and longer term income is a commission on team members. It is a very International business, so you are by no means limited to the UK. Please note that it is totally free to start this opportunity.

Along with marketing or sales experience, you will need to have excellent communication skills - capable of talking to people at all levels. This role would suit somebody who enjoys meeting people, who can work without supervision and is keen to succeed.

Skills / Experience
Interested in helping others improve lifestyle
Good at building relationships
Good at networking with other people
Good Social Media Facebook, Instagram, X or TikTok
Able to work without supervision
Self-motivated
Independent
Ambitious
Keen to learn

To a large extent your background isn't important, although experience in the Internet and Social Media (Facebook, Instagram, X or TikTok) would be an advantage. The main thing is to have the motivation to work without supervision, to have a positive attitude, to be willing to learn and the drive to become successful.

We will provide extensive initial training and ongoing training and support.

title: Marketing Executive
company: Armstrong Lloyd - Marketing Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
MARKETING EXECUTIVE

Our client is an established engineering business delivering complex technical projects, looking for a creative and organised Marketing Executive to support their team. This role plays a key part in translating technical projects into compelling visual and written content, supporting brand growth through social media, website management and marketing collateral.

The ideal candidate has a keen eye for design and the ability to work collaboratively with technical teams to showcase the business's expertise.

Location: Hybrid, Bristol

Salary: £30,000 - £35,000

AS MARKETING EXECUTIVE YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES WILL INCLUDE:
- Design and format high-impact marketing documents, project sheets, brochures, presentations and exhibition materials in line with brand guidelines
- Manage and update website content via WordPress, liaising with the external agency and monitoring analytics for SEO improvements
- Develop and deliver a consistent social media content calendar across LinkedIn, Instagram and other platforms
- Write engaging, well-proofread copy tailored to a professional B2 B audience, simplifying technical content for a broader readership
- Collaborate with project leads and technical teams to gather content and ensure accurate, high-quality output

THE IDEAL MARKETING EXECUTIVE WILL HAVE:
- Proven marketing experience within professional services, construction, consultancy or engineering
- Advanced experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly InDesign and/or Illustrator
- Experience with website editing or content management systems such as WordPress
- Strong copywriting and proofreading skills with excellent attention to detail
- A proactive, organised approach with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines

WHY JOIN THIS BUSINESS AS THEIR MARKETING EXECUTIVE?
- Opportunity to work closely with technical teams on genuinely interesting engineering projects
- Support for ongoing professional development, including progress towards ACIM/MCIM qualifications
- Hybrid working based in Bristol
- Collaborative, supportive environment with scope to bring creativity and new ideas to the role

Our client is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all backgrounds. Every application is reviewed by a real person, not a filter.

Armstrong Lloyd is a marketing specialist recruitment services provider. We specialise in the B2 B space and have a variety of similar jobs available. We offer a personal service that will give you the best possible outcome in the recruitment process.

title: Social Media and Marketing Executive
company: Moxie and Mettle Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Social Media & Marketing Executive

Bristol

£30k-£35k

We're looking for a creative, hands-on Social Media & Marketing Executive to join a family-owned property business in Bristol.

This is a varied role where you'll take ownership of the company's social media and content, while supporting wider marketing activity designed to drive enquiries, strengthen the brand and raise the company's profile within the property market.

This is a standalone marketing role, so we're looking for someone who is confident working independently and taking ownership. You'll need to be self-sufficient, proactive and full of ideas, able to spot opportunities, decide what needs doing and get on with it rather than waiting for direction. We're looking for someone who will bring energy and creativity to the role, constantly looking for what could be done next, how things can be improved and new ways to engage and grow the audience

The Role

You'll be responsible for:
- Managing Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and LinkedIn
- Creating engaging photo, video and written content
- Managing property listings across relevant property platforms
- Creating property descriptions, campaigns, blogs and promotional content
- Supporting lead generation and improving enquiry conversion
- Working with external SEO, content and paid advertising specialists
- Monitoring marketing performance, analytics and ROI
- Creating testimonials, case studies and other brand content
- Building relationships with relevant partners and local organisations
- Keeping an eye on competitor activity, pricing and market trends

About You

We're looking for someone with 2+ years' experience in social media, content or digital marketing who is confident at taking ownership and getting things done.

You'll need:
- Strong social media, copywriting and content creation skills
- Good photography and videography skills
- A creative eye and confidence creating content for different platforms
- A commercial mindset and understanding of lead generation
- Good organisational skills and the ability to work independently
- Basic Canva or Adobe skills

Experience in property, student marketing or another consumer-facing sector would be useful but not essential.

Knowledge of the Bristol market and local scene, including universities, communities and local businesses, would also be an advantage.

The Person

You'll be proactive, creative and commercially minded, with plenty of initiative and a genuine interest in creating great content.

This is a small, close-knit business, so we're looking for someone who is hands-on, personable and happy to get stuck in.

The role is predominantly office-based in Bristol, ideally five days a week, with the possibility of one day working from home.

Bristol £30k-£35k Full-time

title: Trainee Digital Marketing Manager No experience needed (Ref: 6901)
description:
DIGITAL MARKETING TRAINEESHIP (REMOTE)

Become a Digital Marketing Professional and Build Real-World Experience

Are you interested in digital marketing, online business, and helping organisations grow through effective marketing strategies? Do you want to gain practical experience while developing skills that employers are actively looking for?

We are offering a Digital Marketing Traineeship designed to help aspiring digital marketers develop industry-relevant knowledge through structured learning and practical projects.

What You Will Learn

Throughout the traineeship, you will develop an understanding of:
- Digital Marketing Fundamentals
- Marketing Strategy and Planning
- Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)
- Pay-Per-Click (PPC) Advertising
- Social Media Marketing
- Content Marketing
- Email Marketing
- Google Analytics and Marketing Analytics
- Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO)
- Customer Journey Mapping
- Branding and Positioning
- Market Research and Competitor Analysis
- Artificial Intelligence (AI) for Marketing
- Marketing Automation
- Campaign Planning and Performance Measurement
- Marketing Reporting and Data Analysis

Practical Experience

You will work on realistic marketing projects that may include:

- SEO audits and optimisation recommendations
- Social media campaign planning
- Content creation and marketing calendars
- Email marketing campaigns
- Marketing analytics and reporting
- Website optimisation projects
- Competitor research

Ideal Candidate

- Have an interest in marketing, business, and technology
- Enjoy analysing data and solving problems
- Have good communication skills
- Are creative and eager to learn

- Have basic computer skills

No previous digital marketing experience is required. Successful applicants will undertake our paid Digital Marketing training programme before progressing into employment. The cost of the training is the responsibility of the learner, and full guidance and support will be provided throughout the programme.

Benefits
- Remote and flexible learning
- Industry-relevant curriculum
- Portfolio development opportunities
- Practical project experience
- Mentoring and personalised feedback
- Career guidance and employability support
- Opportunity to develop skills sought by modern employers

Entry Requirements

- Access to a computer and internet connection
- Motivation to learn and develop professionally

Career Opportunities

Upon successful completion, learners may pursue roles such as:
- Digital Marketing Executive
- Digital Marketing Specialist
- SEO Executive
- PPC Executive
- Content Marketing Executive
- Social Media Executive
- Email Marketing Executive
- Marketing Coordinator
- Marketing Analyst
- Growth Marketing Executive
- Performance Marketing Executive
- Digital Marketing Assistant

Apply Today

If you are looking to start a career in Digital Marketing and want to gain practical experience while developing a professional portfolio, we would love to hear from you.

Submit your application today and begin your journey towards a career in one of the world's fastest-growing industries.

We advertise this role across multiple UK locations - you only need to apply once and you'll be considered for all of them.
